title.zh: 昼夜交替 · 地球自己在转
title.en: Day and Night · The Earth Itself Is Turning

desc.zh: 不是太阳绕着我们跑：地球绕着自己的轴转，每个地方轮流朝向太阳，于是有了昼夜。转满一圈是一天；站在转动的地面上看，太阳就成了东升西落。
desc.en: The Sun does not circle us: the Earth spins on its own axis and every place takes its turn facing the Sun — that is day and night. One full turn makes a day, and standing on the turning ground, the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west.
